label: Framework SSR · eight shared workloads
boundary: Production HTTP request, routing, SSR and framework response serialization to complete uncompressed HTML over loopback. Static fixture input is available locally; no database or external I/O. Full-document caching is disabled.
parity: Same semantic business content for 4 sections, 32 cards and 160 feature items; 96 products and 480 SVG stars; and 1,000 rows with 12 cells, formatting, branches, escaping and variable-length tag lists. Every URL carries a request-specific freshness value. Generated wrappers/classes and framework scripts outside the business root may differ. Complete response bytes are retained and checked on every timed request. The five showcase pages use the same complete HTML/CSS fixture as SSR Rendering. Exact is explicitly adapted to native styles and supported markup, with matching business content, freshness and escaping; it is not an identical DOM/CSS comparison.
limitations: Different framework shells and hydration protocols produce different payload sizes.
This workload does not measure browser hydration, application startup, database I/O or developer experience.
A separate contract and capture from the synchronous pure-renderer suite; numbers must not be combined.

Every framework uses identical settings within each workload. Core fixtures use 64 capacity connections; showcase fixtures use 16, except Sentry logs (8). These are bounded-concurrency capacity measurements, not a search for each server’s optimal connection count.

Equal-load rates are 10 requests/s for component page, 5 for product grid, 1 for table and other showcase pages, and 0.25 for Sentry logs. Sentry latency runs for 40 seconds; other latency windows are 10 seconds. Lower rates keep the largest production response below overload. All raw sample counts are retained.
Capacity windows are 60 seconds for table, GitHub PR and Sentry logs, and 10 seconds otherwise. Settings are common to all frameworks for each workload.
